actual_tools: Boltz-2 in a completed local GPU run
local Python evidence inspection and compact export
execution.device: local GPU compute for the historical run; local workstation for evidence inspection
execution.implementation: 20-candidate Boltz-2 screen followed by five fixed-seed diffusion samples for each of the top five candidates; no model rerun during this update

observations: The retained prior run screened 20 candidates successfully and completed 25 of 25 five-sample ensemble predictions.
The fixed-seed ensemble ranks NB13_E104Q first with mean composite score 0.9174960599 and standard deviation 0.0080318136.

The compact case retains 25 raw confidence payloads, the complete per-model table, a portable command, the scoring method, and the historical observation that 25 paired CIF files were present in the source run.
A genuine Rosalind launcher call returned ready=true but submitted no sequence and performed no prediction, resampling, or ranking.
interpretation: Repeated model samples support prioritization by structural confidence and consistency within this defined setup.
The ranking is a computational hypothesis for experimental testing.
limitations: Model confidence and contact-derived composite scores are not measured affinity or binding free energy.
The compact repository snapshot omits historical CIF coordinates; a fresh run recreates them from the retained public sequences.
A fixed seed does not characterize all model uncertainty.
Boltz-2 was not rerun during this showcase update.
The exact Boltz package version used for the historical snapshot was not retained.

provenance.note: The builder imports a completed source run's ranking, per-model metrics, and confidence payloads, then checks each paired structure file before generating the preview. Public sequences and portable preparation, execution, and scoring scripts support a fresh run. The Rosalind observation records chooser readiness only.

reproduction: Generate the five historical top-candidate YAML files from the retained public target and candidate sequences.
Run five fixed-seed Boltz samples per candidate with outputs/run-top5-ensemble.sh and record current package versions.
Score the 25 fresh CIF and confidence pairs with outputs/score-top5-ensemble.py and compare them with the retained ranking.
Treat the Rosalind launcher observation separately from every Boltz computation.
